verification.note: Reproduced by reading the tree. Glob of docs/process/reviews/fix-backend-image-addons-dir/** returns only decisions.md and r1/{head.txt,expected.txt,classification.json,fixes.txt}. There is no invariants.md, while other topics such as feature-cloud-sync-settings-gui do have one. r1/classification.json:8-17 lists backend/Dockerfile as CRITICAL and tests/test_backend_dockerfile.py as MEDIUM. backend/Dockerfile:9-10 has the comment and `mkdir -p addons &&`. tests/test_backend_dockerfile.py exists, and its docstring at lines 8-10 labels the behaviour UNSPEC. With no spec and no invariants file, neither touched path appears in a declared touch-point list. The finding's only claim is that the list is missing. It does not show that the code is wrong.

specification_compliance: No spec or invariants.md is declared for this topic. The tested behaviour is marked UNSPEC in tests/test_backend_dockerfile.py:8-10 and points to docs/addons/cloud-sync.md (Installation).
potential_unspecified_behavior: The rule that a backend addon is included in the image whether or not backend/addons/ exists on the host is backed only by an UNSPEC test, not by a declared invariant.
regression_risks: Before this change, the cleanup at backend/Dockerfile:10 (`find addons ... -delete`) failed silently when addons/ was absent. `mkdir -p` now guarantees that addons/ exists before the loop runs.
test_coverage: tests/test_backend_dockerfile.py runs the copy step's shell script both with and without a host addons dir. It covers an addon that sorts first, has a backend and has no manifest (cloud-sync).
